annotations.title: Accept or decline an intro request

description: Accept or decline an intro request that is waiting on the user (status pending in list_matches). Accepting opens a chat with the other member. Declining is private; the requester is not notified and requests expire on their own after 30 days. Confirm with the user before declining.

claim_code.description: The claim_code from sign_up or sign_in, if the account is not connected in this conversation
